readings.source_quote: The situation that we feared is upon us: The trailer tank has ruptured, the static tank is empty and the loft tank is half-empty and we will run out of water tomorrow, even with our "water saving" techniques.

events.description: The static tank level is too low to refill the loft tank, prompting an urgent water resupply request and entry into a critical water contingency plan.
events.source_quote: The static tank is now too low to refill the loft tank. Tomorrow we will enter into a critical water contingency plan. A water resupply is now urgently requested.
